title: Aviary manually observed AI answers input
description: A locally assembled sample of AI answers, their prompts, timestamps, provider labels, cited URLs, and optional answer text. This is not a representative visibility dataset.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time with explicit timezone; the report groups by UTC month.

answerText.description: Optional captured answer text. Used only for local matching against configured entity names and aliases; raw text is not included in the report.

topic.description: Optional operator-assigned topic label; Aviary does not infer it.

intent.description: Optional operator-assigned intent label; Aviary does not infer it.

citationListComplete.description: Whether citedUrls is a complete list. Defaults to true below 50 URLs and false at 50 URLs; set false when a shorter list was also clipped and true when a 50-URL list is confirmed complete. Incomplete next-timestamp lists make absent citations unobserved rather than lost.

model.description: Optional operator-recorded model or version label; Aviary does not infer or verify it.

surface.description: Optional operator-recorded product surface label, such as Search or Browse; Aviary does not infer or verify it.

locale.description: Optional operator-recorded requested locale; Aviary does not infer it from answer text.
